title: Kick targeting in fast iterated local search: code, data and preregistered run records
description: Reproduction package for the paper 'Vuruşları Hedeflemek İçin Öğrenmek Gerekir mi? Hızlı İteratif Yerel Aramada Eğitimsiz Kenar Uzunluğu Vekillerinin Ön-Kayıtlı Sınaması' (submitted to Journal of Combinatorial Optimization): fast 2-opt/Or-opt ILS engine, kick-targeting signals (random, kNN, excess-length and raw-length proxies, LKH-trained GNN, MLPs, online Thompson-ridge), preregistration files (PROTOCOL_v2.json with SHA-256 and OpenTimestamps proof, Bitcoin block 976258), registered exploratory blocks (PROTOCOL_v3_exploratory.json; PROTOCOL_v4_exploratory.json, Bitcoin block 976592) including comparisons with the published NeuroLKH SGN edge scores, equal-kick and online-credit sessions, and an LKH-3.0.13 kick-targeting patch (patch only; third-party code is not redistributed), all per-run JSON records, analysis scripts and paper sources.
